units.source_text: 性情直率的弥兵卫当然也不会无动于衷：

en.t: Naturally, the straightforward Yahei could not remain unmoved either:

units.source_text: “起义成功的当天早上，我们见过他，

en.t: On the very morning the uprising succeeded, we saw him,

units.source_text: 我认为吐他几口吐沫都难消我心头之恨。

en.t: I thought that even spitting in his face several times would not ease the hatred in my heart.

units.source_text: 因着他还敢不知廉耻的来到我们跟前，

en.t: For he still had the shameless nerve to come before us,

units.source_text: 恭喜我们起义成功什么的。”

en.t: and say things like congratulations on the success of our uprising."
